title: Multiple definition when link grpc static library
body:
### What version of gRPC and what language are you using?

v1.64.0 

### What operating system (Linux, Windows,...) and version?

ubuntu 18.04.6 LTS

### What runtime / compiler are you using (e.g. python version or version of gcc)

gcc 7.5.0

### What did you do?
Followed the instructions at 'https://grpc.io/docs/languages/cpp/quickstart/' with updated cmake options to build gRPC dependencies from source with static linking. 
The gRPC/protobuf build and install are successful. All good so far.

Next, I compile my application and attempt to link all the  libraries above, but I get this linking error:

```
/mnt/e/x/thirdparty/lib/linux/x86_64/grpc/libutf8_range.a(utf8_range.c.o):utf8_range.c:(.text+0x100): first defined here
/mnt/e/x/thirdparty/lib/linux/x86_64/grpc/libutf8_range_lib.a(utf8_range.c.o): In function `utf8_range_ValidPrefix':
utf8_range.c:(.text+0x2b0): multiple definition of `utf8_range_ValidPrefix'

/mnt/e/x/thirdparty/lib/linux/x86_64/grpc/libutf8_validity.a(utf8_range.c.o): In function `utf8_range_ValidPrefix':
utf8_range.c:(.text+0x2b0): multiple definition of `utf8_range_ValidPrefix'
/mnt/e/x/thirdparty/lib/linux/x86_64/grpc/libutf8_range.a(utf8_range.c.o):utf8_range.c:(.text+0x2b0): first defined here
```

### What did you expect to see?
100% successful gRPC/protobuf build and install (yes, I saw this).
100% successful build for custom Ubuntu 18.04.6 gRPC/protobuf application (no, I did not see this).

### What did you see instead?
Unexpected linker errors in my custom Ubuntu 18.04.6 gRPC/protobuf application, specifically:
```
/mnt/e/x/thirdparty/lib/linux/x86_64/grpc/libutf8_range.a(utf8_range.c.o):utf8_range.c:(.text+0x100): first defined here
```

### Anything else we should know about your project / environment?
I've looked up  https://github.com/grpc/grpc/tree/master/examples/android/helloworld, this example works fine in my computer. I had found the depending relations of these libraries in [BUILD](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/BUILD) file, but it does not describe the corresponding relationship between functions and static libraries. 

I'm a little confused about which static libraries listed above should be integrated in a specific project.
